trigger: A task is first encountered, or the latest candidate failed a public artifact contract stage.
action: Compile the task capability card into the initial Harness and verify the exact candidate boundary before semantic or performance search.
guardrails: Only registered non-semantic normalization is allowed; paths, fields, hunks, program semantics, tests, and scores remain under the strict trusted codec and evaluator.
provenance: Moss typed recovery plus staged evaluator contracts

derivation.semantic_change_note: Moss binds a task-specific capability card before v001, requires a verifier workflow, and exposes exact public failure stages without granting scorer authority to the model.

trigger: A correct incumbent exists and one measured bottleneck is supported by evidence.
action: Keep the incumbent and change one bounded mechanism aimed at that bottleneck.
guardrails: Do not bundle unrelated structural changes; require a falsifiable expected signal.

derivation.semantic_change_note: Only the measured-fact control pattern is ported; task-specific payload and thresholds are excluded.

trigger: The incumbent family is plausibly saturated or repeated local changes are flat.
action: Reset the architecture and propose a qualitatively different decomposition.
guardrails: Start from a frozen reference or explicit root; the child inherits no parent score.

derivation.semantic_change_note: Moss implements a reference-root restart without importing task-specific thresholds.

trigger: At least two evidence-bearing attempts failed to improve and share an assumption.
action: State the shared assumption and construct a child that deliberately inverts it.
guardrails: The inverted assumption must be named; arbitrary novelty does not qualify.

derivation.semantic_change_note: The inversion proposal is available only after evidence-bearing attempts.

trigger: Two frozen parents have complementary mechanisms or resource profiles.
action: Build a new child from explicit parent contributions and re-evaluate from zero.
guardrails: Do not splice arbitrary text; reject same-niche duplicates and inherited scores.

derivation.semantic_change_note: Moss recombines correct distinct structural signatures without importing task-specific scores.

trigger: The latest attempt passed the artifact boundary but failed compilation or correctness.
action: Repair the earliest failing correctness stage before any performance optimization.
guardrails: A failed attempt remains in reliability evidence; environment errors are separate.

derivation.semantic_change_note: Moss-native typed recovery uses only public reason-coded failure state.

trigger: A first-encounter instance trajectory is fully sealed and its score can no longer change.
action: Extract task descriptors, initial-Harness choices, update actions, outcomes, costs, counterexamples, and scope into versioned Experience Records before the next unseen instance.
guardrails: Never update the Builder before scoring the current instance; same-instance rounds cannot teach one another.

derivation.semantic_change_note: The trusted controller executes this once after current-instance arms seal; it is never a Harness decision.
